description.value:
Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 142. Category: technique. Rank 3.

Rank 3 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 40
Prerequisites: none
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: self(150 foot line)
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: Beam
The user creates an energy orb in each hand and
places them together to fire a large powerful beam.
Targets in this 5 ft wide, 150 foot long line must make
a dexterity saving throw taking 6d10 Ki Damage on a
fail, half on a success.
